strings.subtitle: — Fail rang·gala —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Donangna aro watata dakmangja. Naa button-ko jakkala.
strings.shred_button: R A N G · G A L A
strings.ssd_warning:
Seng·ani! SSD-o TRIM-ko jakkale chu·sokgipa u·m·a rang·galna man·ja.
Naa program HDD-ni.
strings.confirm_text:
Fail "{name}" ko chu·sokgen aro mu·atgen.

Re·ba?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS gipin data stream (ADS) kam ka·ja.
• USN journal rong·ja.
• Shadow copy aro cloud sync
  (OneDrive aro gipin) dika man·ja.
strings.status_full: Noko gimik ching·a zero-o chu·soka. Pila·na man·ja — kolomrang zero mang·ko nikgen.
strings.status_fast: Skotong, ja·gring aro 4 MB patti-rang chu·soka. Pila·giparang chu·sokjaha, indiba bak·bakani gimin, jakkal·giparang-ni kolomrango apalgipa fail pila·na man·ja. Rong·gipa ki·taprang-na CHENG·A mode-ko jakkala.
strings.error_permission: Fail-o napna man·ja. Gipin program-o o·gipa ong·naba donga. Rang·ata aro gipin baksa naja.
strings.error_not_found: Fail man·jaha. Ba·chiba mu·ataha ong·naba donga.
strings.error_is_symlink: Naa symbolic link. Link-rangko rang·galna man·ja — nang·gimin fail name donggen.
strings.error_reparse: Naa biap fail (OneDrive ba agan·gijagipa). Uni data cloud-o donga, disk-o ong·ja — i·a-o rang·galna nang·gipa dongja.
strings.error_not_file: Naa fail ong·ja (folder ba gipin). Fail donangbo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Naa fail-o gipin raka link-rang donga ({n} gimik). Raka link-rang-o dal·gipa dongja — bimung gimik apsan. Da·alni rama-o rang·galode, data chu·sokgen aro 32 byte-o katgen, indiba dong·gipa bak gipin link-rangchi napna man·gen. Skang gimik link-rangko mu·ata.
strings.error_compressed:
Fail ko dong·ata, enkript keta ba kan·a. Zero-o chu·sokani gimin da·gipa data rang·galna man·ja, maina NTFS u·arangko gipin rama-o don·a.

Bidingo gala: jakra·gipa click → Bidingo → Bil·gipa → "Dong·ata" aro/ba "Enkript"-oni mark gala. Unikode SHREDDER-ko gipin baksa jakkala.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} failrang nam·ataha.
U·tani bitan: {size}.

Nambatna skang talistko nia.
Ia kamko ku·sina man·ja.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Queueoni pilak {count} failrangko rim·atgenma?

Failrangko ja·manaha — talistko man·a.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fail "{name}" mingsa hard linkrang gnang ({nlink} pilak).

Pilak bimingrangna data nam·atako man·gen.
Indiba 32 byte-a biming gipinrangni gia donggen.

Ia byte-rangko jakisa rong·atna nang·gen.
